title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-02-13
lineage: Dat (Sony R500) -> Sound Devices 744T -> Samplitude Professional v10.2 -> FLAC
source: SBD -> Master Reel (7 inch 1/2 Track at 15ips) -> Dat (48k)

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear Miller soundboard capture of a legendary 2/13/70 show featuring an all‑time Dark Star, The Other One and Lovelight.
ai_review.review: The Miller‑fixed SBD source is praised as crisp, clean and virtually flawless, letting the band’s historic second electric set shine.  Reviewers rave about the transcendent Dark Star, monster The Other One and soaring Lovelight (plus a stellar Smokestack Lightning), calling the performance one of the era’s finest.  Overall sentiment is overwhelmingly positive with only a single mixed‑feel review.

ai_rating.rationale: 22 reviews, 19 five‑star, 1 four‑star and 1 three‑star; the vast majority praise both the music and Miller soundboard transfer, yielding a strong combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Miller’s fix provides a crisp, clear mix with no noticeable drop‑outs or distortion; reviewers describe the sound as “strong,” “most excellent,” and the clearest source available.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Both sets flow seamlessly, with the acoustic opener leading into a powerhouse electric second set that builds into marathon jams; the show is lauded for its tight pacing and the way the band locks in on extended improvisations.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s tone and improvisational brilliance on Dark Star and The Other One are highlighted as exceptional.
band_member_comments.Phil: Phil’s bass lock‑in is noted especially during Lovelight, providing a solid foundation for the jams.
band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen’s organ/vocal work (and his rare guitar spot on Katie May) receive praise, adding soulful texture to the set.
